pages.text: Fishing Hats are items that can affect what you catch when you go fishing. By default they all have a small boost to catching fish alive. But each colour has it's own special effect. You can see these effects listed, on the next few pages.
pages.title: Fishing Hats

pages.text: Crafting the different colours, simply requires placing pearls all around the basic hat.
$(l)Input:$() Leather Cap$(br)$(l)Fluid:$() 16000mB Fish Oil$(br)$(l)Output:$() Bucket Hat$(br)$(l)Time:$() 25s
pages.title: Bucket Hat
Bucket Hat
pages.text: The basic hat adds even more chance for catching fish alive.

pages.title: White Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: Fish caught while wearing this hat, think they're in fresh water.

pages.title: Green Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text:
Fish think you are stood in a 
jungle biome. How stupid are they?

pages.title: Yellow Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: Fish think that they are being in brackish waters aka a beach.

pages.title: Orange Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: All loot is rejected. You can only catch fish while wearing this hat.

pages.title: Red Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: Holy hell these fish are hot. Fish think it's the nether.

pages.title: Gold Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: No fish will bite your rod. You will only catch junk or treasures!

pages.title: Brown Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: This one makes fish believe that you are underground at y10.

pages.title: Purple Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: This is one powerful magical hat. Everything you catch is enchanted.

pages.title: Blue Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: This hat is all about the manosphere, you can only ever find male fish while wearing this very daring hat.

pages.title: Black Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: Hat of the dead. All fish you catch will be raw. No living.

pages.title: Pink Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: Hat of the amazons. Only female fish can ever be found.

pages.title: Silver Pearl Bucket Hat
pages.text: Salty waters are what the fish will believe.
